note: Which building produces which unit. Every unit in data/units.json appears exactly once (tests/gallery/production.test.js). art: game = drawn by src/render/buildings.js, concept = gallery/structure-art.js. A unit a lab upgrades to is listed under the lab. HQs build each faction's own infantry (the soldier is shown).

buildings.name: HQ
buildings.blurb: Each faction builds its own infantry here, as many as it can pay for (all are shown; a faction builds only its own). The HQ and every city also build the infantry that the garage, factory and airfield unlock.

buildings.name: Garage
buildings.blurb: Wheeled vehicles, from the recon car to the rocket launcher, and the motorcycle infantry. Holding one unlocks the mechanic, who is built at the HQ and cities.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.blurb: Treaded armour and the big guns. Holding one unlocks AT infantry, who are built at the HQ and cities.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.blurb: The surface fleet, from destroyer to carrier.

buildings.name: Sub Pen
buildings.blurb: Submarines in a concrete pen, and the divers who swim from it.

buildings.name: Airfield
buildings.blurb: Copters, fighters and bombers. Holding one unlocks the RPG trooper, who is built at the HQ and cities.

buildings.name: Hover Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: while you hold it, the tank on your factory menu becomes a hover tank.

buildings.name: Stealth Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: while you hold it, tanks, missile copters, fighters and bombers on your menus become their stealth versions.

buildings.name: Heavy Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: while you hold it, the tank becomes a heavy tank and the battleship a dreadnought.

buildings.name: Missile Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: while you hold it, the tank becomes a missile tank and the submarine a missile sub.

buildings.name: Engineer Works
buildings.blurb: Gear on the front and stacked wall blocks: the fixed defences and walls.

laid.note: Never bought: laid by a unit.

shelved.note: Shelved for now: not built anywhere (kept in the data for the labs). Four buildings are shelved with them: the chemical plant, support factory, artillery range and agency.
